description: This file contains unit tests for validation and extraction functions related to callback URLs within a handler package in a Go-based project. It particularly tests URL validation, port extraction, callback candidate gathering, and related edge cases.

methods.name: TestValidateCallbackURL_Valid
methods.description: Tests validation of a reachable and valid callback URL generated by a test HTTP server.

methods.name: TestValidateCallbackURL_Empty
methods.description: Tests validation to ensure empty URL returns an error.

methods.name: TestValidateCallbackURL_InvalidFormat
methods.description: Tests validation rejects URLs with invalid formats or schemes.

methods.name: TestValidateCallbackURL_InvalidScheme
methods.description: Ensures URLs with non-http/https schemes are rejected.

methods.name: TestValidateCallbackURL_NoHost
methods.description: Checks that URLs without a host component are invalid.

methods.name: TestValidateCallbackURL_Unreachable
methods.description: Verifies behavior when validating URLs that are well-formed but unreachable.

methods.name: TestExtractPortFromURL_WithPort
methods.description: Checks port extraction from URLs with explicit ports.

methods.name: TestExtractPortFromURL_Empty
methods.description: Tests port extraction from empty or invalid URLs.

methods.name: TestExtractPortFromURL_InvalidURL
methods.description: Ensures invalid URL strings do not cause crashes and return empty port.

methods.name: TestGatherCallbackCandidates_BaseURLOnly
methods.description: Verifies candidate list when only base URL is provided.

methods.name: TestGatherCallbackCandidates_WithDiscovery
methods.description: Tests URL candidate gathering when additional discovery info is available.

methods.name: TestGatherCallbackCandidates_WithClientIP
methods.description: Checks candidate list when a client IP is provided instead of full discovery.

methods.name: TestGatherCallbackCandidates_Deduplication
methods.description: Verifies that duplicate URLs are deduplicated in the candidate list.

methods.name: TestGatherCallbackCandidates_EmptyStrings
methods.description: Ensures empty or whitespace-only URLs are ignored in discovery.

methods.name: TestGatherCallbackCandidates_ClientIPWithoutPort
methods.description: Checks fallback to default port when client IP lacks explicit port.

methods.name: TestGatherCallbackCandidates_PreferredPortOverride
methods.description: Verifies that preferred discovery URL ports override default.

methods.name: TestGatherCallbackCandidates_MultipleCandidatesOrdering
methods.description: Ensures candidate URLs are ordered with base, preferred, then others.

methods.name: TestValidateCallbackURL_PreventSSRF_PrivateIPs
methods.description: Notes current behavior allowing private IPs; potential security concern.

methods.name: TestValidateCallbackURL_LongURL
methods.description: Tests handling of very long URLs.

methods.name: TestExtractPortFromURL_EdgeCases
methods.description: Checks extraction from URLs with path, query, fragments, and boundary port values.

methods.name: TestGatherCallbackCandidates_NilDiscovery
methods.description: Ensures no panic occurs if discovery info is nil.

methods.name: TestGatherCallbackCandidates_EmptyClientIP
methods.description: Validates behavior with empty client IP.

methods.name: TestGatherCallbackCandidates_IPv6
methods.description: Tests handling of IPv6 addresses in base URL and candidate gathering.

methods.name: TestGatherCallbackCandidates_MalformedURLsInDiscovery
methods.description: Validates skipping invalid URLs in the discovery list.

methods.name: TestGatherCallbackCandidates_WhitespaceInCandidates
methods.description: Ensures whitespace is trimmed from candidate URLs.
